## Install

Easiest: install **Padvinder** from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/padvinder) with the CurseForge app or WowUp, then updates come in by themselves.

By hand:

1. Download **Padvinder-VERSION.zip** below (not "Source code").
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\` so you get `AddOns\Padvinder\Padvinder.toc`.
3. Restart the game. For the route arrow you also need [TomTom](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/tomtom).

Updating: delete the old `Padvinder` folder first. Your recorded paths are kept. Type `/pad` in game for the commands.
